name: serialized-checked-values-and-ambient-callees
description: A value a satisfies expression checks, or an assertion to unknown hides, keeps the data members of the type it is checked against and of its own type where it reaches a destination. A function or method a declaration file declares, a member it merges into a platform interface included, has no body the analysis reads, so a value passed to its unknown parameter keeps its data members. A member of an interface a declaration file declares and a class of the target implements runs that class's code, so a value passed to it that nothing reads keeps nothing, and its member is still reported as written and never read.
